Of Oberlauterbach, Bas-Rhin, a few miles from Stundwiller.
Father, with Madelaine Werner, of Marie Angélique Schmitt, born 15 May 1795, who married Antoine Philipps at Stundwiller
in 1817. Wife of Pierre Schmitt of Oberlauterbach, Bas-Rhin, and mother of Marie Angélique,
who married Antoine Philipps of Stundwiller in 1817.
